title: Athena refuses; Hector finds Paris
intro: The prayer receives a one-line refusal. Hector reaches Paris' richly built home and finds him tending his weapons.

notes.text: νηός, temple; πόλις ἄκρη, citadel.
τῇσι, for them, dat fem pl; οἴγνυμι, open: 3sg aor act.
καλλιπάρῃος, fair-cheeked; Κισσηΐς, daughter of Cisseus. Theano is Antenor's wife.
τίθημι 3pl aor, appointed; ἱέρεια, priestess: acc sg, predicate to Theano.
ὀλολυγή, ritual cry: dat sg; ἀνέχω 3pl 2aor, raised their hands.
αἱρέω 2aor ptc nom fem sg, taking; τίθημι unaugmented 3sg aor, placed the robe.
εὔχομαι pres mid ptc, praying; ἀράομαι 3sg impf mid, made supplication.
ἐρυσίπτολις, city-protecting: voc sg; δῖα θεάων, divine among goddesses. The epithet contrasts painfully with Athena's hostility.
ἄγνυμι, break: 2sg aor imperative, not ἄγω; break Diomedes' spear.
πρηνής, face down: acc sg; δίδωμι 2sg aor imperative + πίπτω epic 2aor inf, “grant that he fall.”
προπάροιθε + gen, in front of the gates.
ἱερεύω, sacrifice: 1pl fut indicative after ὄφρα, promising consequence / purpose; Homer need not use Attic-style subj here.
Yearling, ungoaded cattle; the same vowed offering as at 94 and 275.
ἐλεέω 2sg aor subj, if you take pity; direct address now, rather than the earlier third person.
ἀνανεύω, nod up / refuse: 3sg impf. A rejecting gesture; not a nod of assent.
βαίνω 3sg plup act, had gone / was on his way; Hector's journey progresses during the prayer.
τεύχω, make / build: 3sg aor; Paris had the house built with expert craftsmen.
ἐριβῶλαξ, deep-soiled: dat sg with Troy; τέκτων, craftsman / builder: nom pl.
Private chamber; hall; courtyard. Three parts of the residence.
Near, + gen; Priam's and Hector's houses understood.
ἑνδεκάπηχυς, eleven cubits long: acc neut sg with spear; imposing scale.
δόρυ gen sg with πάροιθε, at the front of the shaft; αἰχμή, spear-point, subject of λάμπετο, gleamed.
θέω, run: unaugmented 3sg impf; πόρκης, ring / ferrule securing the spear-head; gold ring runs around it.
ἕπω, attend to / look after: pres act ptc acc sg with Paris; armour as object. Not ἕπομαι, follow.
θώρηξ, breastplate; ἀγκύλος, curved; τόξα, bow; ἁφάω, handle / examine: epic pres ptc acc sg.
δμῳή, enslaved woman: dat pl; γυνή dat pl. Household workers around Helen.
ἧμαι 3sg impf, sat; περικλυτός, famous / splendid; κέλευε impf, directed their handiwork.
νεικέω, rebuke: epic 3sg aor; αἰσχρός, shaming / reproachful; ἔπος dat pl. Speech follows.
